dashr#dashr 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。dsh 的 RLM 模式：通过统一的 rlm() 函数实现递归子代理——以一等 Python 函数调用生成、等待、链式传递子代理。附带常驻 IPython 内核、tools.* 绑定与上下文即变量。

posts.en:
dashr#dashr is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. RLM mode for dsh: recursive sub-agents via a unified rlm() function — spawn, await, and chain child agents as first-class Python calls. Adds a persistent IPython kernel with tools.* bindings and context-as-variable.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8d6b31a4d9630a9e5dc2.html
